crossRefs.note: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.
But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may…
No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in…
Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Makkedah
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua

translations.web: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: The whole army returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one dared to utter a word against the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: that all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
